name: Bokura no Roshutsu Game 2
source:
Himari-chan has to do a dare after losing the "punishment game".
At the park she plays on the bar and swingset without panties.
In the shopping district she has to streak, and buy something from a store.
With all eyes on her exposed little body, she feels a special tingle,
and is enjoying this game more and more!
translation:
姬玛丽酱在“惩罚游戏”失败后必须进行一次挑战。
在公园里，她不穿内裤在酒吧和秋千上玩耍。
在购物区，她必须裸奔，从商店买东西。
所有人的目光都集中在她裸露的小身体上，她感到一种特殊的刺痛，
并且越来越喜欢这个游戏！
